note: Commercial vocabulary for Plans, Subscriptions and Quotations. A plan's base_price is per MONTH and includes seat_max employees; per_user_price is per extra employee per month. cycles maps a billing cycle to the months it bills for. Plan features are stored on the row as {"modules": [module keys]}.
subscription_alert_note: SmartPRS 2 billing:alerts parity (owner, 13 Nov 2026): the workspace's administrators are told on each of these days before the subscription ends, and every day of the grace period (in-app bell, email, and WhatsApp through the approved renewal template).

onprem.licence_alert_note: Who is told when a machine other than the bound server uses a licence (SmartPRS 2 alertSalesMismatch). Blank = the platform mailbox's own From address.

expiry_modes.renew: On expiry the install stops until a new code is entered
expiry_modes.notify: On expiry the install stops and shows an 'LC expired' notice (SmartPRS 2: both modes block; notify only changes the message)
